text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says commitments over social benefits can not be reversed.
- French Justice Minister Jacques Toubon says France plans to help Morocco set up trade courts.
- Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes says Morocco does its best to curb illegal immigration.
- Recycling waste could be the solution to protect environment.
- Five-year plan expected to help Morocco overcome economic weaknesses starting this year, not elaborated yet.
- On agenda of autumn session of parliament due to start on Friday, draft laws to shape future Moroccan society.
